aviation_incidents.headline: 加拿大航空AC1769據報收到TCAS爬升指令 續飛溫哥華平安降落
aviation_incidents.summary: 加拿大航空AC1769於11月17日自棕櫚泉起飛，據報波音737 MAX 8爬升至約11,400呎時收到空中防撞系統指令，要求升至12,000呎；附近一架塞斯納小飛機當時據稱沒有回應。班機續飛溫哥華並平安降落，美加主管機關尚未公布調查結果。
aviation_incidents.headline_en: Air Canada AC1769 reportedly receives TCAS climb advisory, lands safely in Vancouver
aviation_incidents.summary_en: Air Canada flight AC1769 departed Palm Springs for Vancouver on November 17. Its Boeing 737 MAX 8 reportedly received a traffic collision avoidance system advisory to climb to 12,000 feet while passing about 11,400 feet; a nearby Cessna was said to be unresponsive. The flight continued to Vancouver and landed safely. No findings have been published by US or Canadian authorities.

taiwan_aviation.headline: 民航局舉辦無人機及先進空中交通論壇 聚焦國際航空安全規範
taiwan_aviation.summary: 民航局11月23日舉辦無人機及先進空中交通論壇，邀國外民航主管機關與專家分享經驗，聚焦國際發展及航空安全規範。民航局指出，先進空中交通實際營運仍需適航認證、安全監理及空域整合機制。
taiwan_aviation.headline_en: Taiwan CAA holds drone and advanced air mobility forum focused on international safety
taiwan_aviation.summary_en: Taiwan’s Civil Aeronautics Administration held a drone and advanced air mobility forum on November 23, inviting foreign aviation regulators and experts to share experience. The forum focused on international developments and aviation safety rules. The agency said advanced air mobility operations still require airworthiness certification, safety oversight and airspace integration.

taiwan_aviation.headline: 航空短訊：亞太永續航空燃料大會在新加坡登場 LATAM Airlines公布A321XLR客艙設計 規劃搭載174人
taiwan_aviation.summary: 亞太永續航空燃料大會在新加坡展開，新加坡設定2030年永續航空燃料占比3%至5%的目標。另，LATAM Airlines公布A321XLR客艙設計，規劃搭載174名乘客。
taiwan_aviation.headline_en: Aviation briefs: Sustainable aviation fuel conference opens in Singapore; LATAM Airlines unveils A321XLR cabin for 174
taiwan_aviation.summary_en: The Asia-Pacific sustainable aviation fuel conference has opened in Singapore, which targets a 3% to 5% sustainable aviation fuel share by 2030. Separately, LATAM Airlines has unveiled its A321XLR cabin design, with planned capacity for 174 passengers.

international_aviation.headline: 澳洲航空以A321XLR汰換737-800 首批737-800開始退役
international_aviation.summary: 澳洲航空在溫頓計畫下，以A321XLR及A220-300汰換波音737-800，已訂購48架A321XLR，並在2026財政年度接收6架。澳航已簽約將44架737-800及88具發動機售予AerFin，首批飛機開始退役。換裝預估自2027年起每年增加1.5億至2億澳元獲利；A321XLR布里斯本至馬尼拉國際首航延至2027年2月1日，期間由A330-200執飛。
international_aviation.headline_en: Qantas begins retiring 737-800s as it replaces them with A321XLRs
international_aviation.summary_en: Under Project Winton, Qantas is replacing Boeing 737-800s with Airbus A321XLRs and A220-300s. It has ordered 48 A321XLRs and received six in its 2026 financial year. Qantas has agreed to sell 44 737-800s and 88 engines to AerFin, with initial retirements under way. The switch is forecast to add AUD 150 million to AUD 200 million annually to earnings from 2027. The A321XLR’s Brisbane–Manila international debut has moved to February 1, 2027, with A330-200s covering the route until then.

international_aviation.headline: 海軍陸戰隊12月8日將舉行實彈演練 勁蜂一型攻擊無人機預定參訓
international_aviation.summary: 海軍陸戰隊預定12月8日在高雄左營海灘一帶進行實彈演練，中科院研製的勁蜂一型攻擊無人機將由兩棲偵搜大隊偵二中隊操作參訓。空域預定下午4時至晚間8時管制；該機配備光電與紅外線設備，可日夜搜索。
international_aviation.headline_en: Marine Corps plans Kaohsiung live-fire drill with 勁蜂一型 attack drone
international_aviation.summary_en: The Marine Corps plans a December 8 live-fire exercise near Zuoying Beach in Kaohsiung, with a 勁蜂一型 attack drone developed by 中科院 operated by the amphibious reconnaissance unit’s Second Reconnaissance Squadron. Airspace controls are scheduled from 4 p.m. to 8 p.m. The drone carries electro-optical and infrared equipment for day and night searches.
